mechanism: Model price (or MA) as a discrete harmonic oscillator whose 2nd finite difference is proportional to level with ratio R∈(0,4) tied to cycle period N; trade/sense on sign flips of the 1st difference of that residual (negative→positive = cycle min / buy; positive→negative = cycle max / sell), avoiding explicit mean m.
data_needed: Price series or iMA; tunable R (1…399) mapping to target cycle period N
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a period-tuned cycle-phase sensor from finite differences rather than FFT/Hilbert, with explicit R↔N coupling and extremum detection via difference-of-difference sign changes.

mechanism: Extend the harmonic residual with damping S: positive S drives oscillatory decay (cycle collapse); critical S ends oscillation; negative S grows amplitude so the EA reacts to cycle onset. Same 1st-difference sign flips generate entries.
data_needed: Same price/MA input; S ∈ [-1000,+1000] plus R
why_new_for_mis: Turns cycle sensing into a lifecycle sensor (onset vs decay vs non-oscillatory) via signed damping—useful MIS change/volatility gate beyond static period filters.

mechanism: Generalized harmonic oscillator: take a leading finite difference of predetermined order (e.g. 7th) and add weighted lower-order differences down to 1st; sign change of that composite is the trading/sensing trigger. Higher leading order fires rarer, more specific price patterns; weights can be fit to non-cyclical patterns too.
data_needed: Price or MA window long enough for order-n differences; weight vector per difference order
why_new_for_mis: Frames multi-order finite-difference banks as a pattern/regime template matcher—MIS can score which order/weight combo is active as a structural regime fingerprint.
quote: The generalized oscillator will only react to certain price combinations. In other words, it looks for certain patterns.

mechanism: Replace linear restoring force with sign, quadratic, van der Pol, or cubic Duffing nonlinearities (plus LWMA-of-SMAs mean via Markov finite-difference identity). Sign oscillator switches among 5 modes from price path; Duffing can sit in two stable states; VdP historically models deterministic chaos. Mode identity / bistability is the sensor.
why_new_for_mis: Supplies MIS a small bank of nonlinear dynamical modes (multi-mode, chaotic, bistable) as regime labels rather than single linear cycle phase.
quote: depending on external conditions and its parameters, this oscillator can be in two stable states.

mechanism: Log oscillator: ordinary oscillator residual on the left, log-price residual as a filter that only bites on large moves.
